load_pretrained_encoder: load pretrained encoder, predictor, and target encoder from a checkpoint file
load_checkpoint_training: load full training checkpoint including encoder, predictor, optimizer, and scaler state
init_video_model: initialize video vision transformer encoder and action-conditioned predictor for self-supervised learning
init_opt: initialize AdamW optimizer with learning rate and weight decay schedulers for training
load_pretrained_predictor: load pretrained predictor and target encoder weights from a checkpoint for fine-tuning
